# msl_ingest_credentials (Data Source)

Lists MSL5 **Ingest Credentials** (`/api/v1/streams/{stream_id}/ingest_credentials`) for a given stream.

> **Note**: Passwords are never exposed in data source output.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `stream_id` (String) ID of the stream to list ingest credentials for.

### Read-Only

- `credentials` (Attributes List) List of ingest credentials for the specified stream. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (String) Hashing algorithm used for the password.
- `description` (String) Optional description for the credential.
- `expiry_date` (String) RFC3339 expiry date, or empty string if the credential does not expire.
- `id` (String) Credential ID (UUID).
- `stream_id` (String) ID of the parent stream.
- `username` (String) Username for ingest authentication.
